legend.review: none = high-confidence, no action needed · confirm = low-confidence or authored, needs ACCEPT/MODIFY/REJECT · open = genuinely undefined, reviewer may direct or leave open

decisions.decision: Primary action = solid FIP red (#EB2D37) square button, white regular-weight label; secondary = 2px black outline square; tertiary = underlined black text link. One primary per view; red is ceremony, so it is used sparingly even for actions.
decisions.evidence: rectilinear standard + red-as-ceremony role; no UI controls exist in the standard
decisions.reasoning: Squares from the standard's geometry; red for the single ceremonial action keeps 'one red' discipline visible.
decisions.alternatives: black-fill primary with red reserved for identity only (still live option)

decisions.decision: Zero radius anywhere. No shadows. Structure carried by rules: 2px black section rules, 1px pewter hairlines for tables. Everything rectilinear.
decisions.evidence: all figures rectilinear; no corner/shadow language anywhere in the standard
decisions.reasoning: Absence is itself the evidence; the standard defines a ruled, measured world.

decisions.decision: One family (Helvetica-class stand-in: Arimo), weights as roles: Light = quiet formal accents, Regular = default text, Medium = headings and key labels (web role per the standard), Bold = reserved for signage-style emphasis (rare).
decisions.evidence: weight→use mapping quoted from the standard; website rule (medium for identity zone)
decisions.reasoning: Direct mapping from the standard, extended conservatively to screens.

decisions.decision: Screen rhythm (AUTHORED interpretation, no sizes exist in source): page title 32/400; section headings 20/500; body 16/1.6; metadata 13 grey; bilingual pairings same size both languages.
decisions.evidence: sizes UNDEFINED in the standard; rhythm authored to a plain, generous reading
decisions.reasoning: Declared interpretation; equality rule honored (both languages equal size/weight).

decisions.decision: FIP red strictly for ceremony: masthead accent device, the single primary action, identity zone marks. Black = text/structure; white = ground; pewter = de-emphasis (metadata, secondary labels). Status and errors are NOT colour-coded (see D-10).
decisions.evidence: standard restricts red to flag/identity; pewter reserved to ministerial arms there — we extend it to de-emphasis
decisions.reasoning: Keeps the one-red discipline; avoids importing alarm semantics the source never had.
decisions.alternatives: pewter for all secondary text; red also for errors (rejected: alarm semantics are unevidenced and collide with other systems' conventions)

decisions.decision: White ground; #F4F4F4 grey band for section separation; black 2px rules as structural events; no elevation anywhere.
decisions.evidence: white/black standard colourways; bands authored as the plainest separator
decisions.reasoning: Ruled, flat, formal.

decisions.decision: Task-first order (most important first), titles short (2–4 words principle extended to screens), structure over decoration; reading order explicit in markup.
decisions.evidence: content style guide: intuitive/targeted/consistent; applied-title limits; plain language mandate
decisions.reasoning: Quoted requirements applied to interface structure.

decisions.decision: Top bar: white, black bottom rule, identity zone at left (red accent bar + title — generic, no Crown marks), nav links regular with medium active state underlined in black (not red — red stays ceremonial). Footer: bottom-right zone reserved for the system's wordmark placeholder (plain text).
decisions.evidence: website bookends rule (signature TL header / wordmark BR footer) applied with generic placeholders
decisions.reasoning: Bookends are observed doctrine; substitution of marks with placeholders is our policy.

decisions.decision: The signature structural device: primary page titles and key labels render bilingually (English | French, side-by-side, thin divider; over-under when narrow). Body content stays in the app's own language. Where a string exists in one language only, no signposting line is fabricated (that rule governs official publications, not this derived app) — carried as system nuance.
decisions.evidence: side-by-side bilingual + over-under fallback are core observed rules; scope intensity is our choice
decisions.reasoning: This is the system's most structural trait; applying it at title/label level expresses identity without breaking app usability.

decisions.decision: Status is word-first, never colour-coded: plain text labels in a ruled box — 'Available' (black on white), 'On loan' (black on #F4F4F4), 'Overdue' (black text with 2px black left rule — emphasis by structure, not hue). Words carry meaning; structure carries emphasis.
decisions.evidence: no status semantics in the standard; safety red explicitly signage-only
decisions.reasoning: Deliberately inverts the usual colour-coded status convention; keeps red pure and prevents Triage-style red-state reading.
decisions.alternatives: red for overdue (rejected for ceremony purity and collision risk)

decisions.decision: Fields: square, 1.5px black border, label above (medium, 13), helper text pewter; focus = border thickens to 2px + offset outer 1px black line; error = 2px black left rule on a grey field + plain-language sentence under it.
decisions.evidence: no form evidence; ruled/measured register extended
decisions.reasoning: High-contrast structural focus (no colour), consistent with D-05.

decisions.decision: Small fixed sets (≤ ~12) = native select squared like a field. Larger/filtered selection out of scope; platform fallback, marked as improvisation.
decisions.evidence: none captured
decisions.reasoning: Same honesty rule as the platform; no invented combobox.

decisions.decision: Notices = ruled boxes (2px black top rule, grey ground) with plain, non-bureaucratic sentences; what happened + what happens next in one or two sentences; no toasts.
decisions.evidence: plain-language mandate quoted; no feedback component exists in the standard
decisions.reasoning: Ruled box as vessel; plain-language rule governs copy.

decisions.decision: High-consequence flow confirms in a square dialog: 2px black frame, consequence sentence in plain words, confirm = solid black square labelled with the verb, cancel = outline square. Never pre-focused.
decisions.evidence: no pattern in source; register derived
decisions.reasoning: Black severity keeps red ceremonial; structural emphasis.

decisions.decision: Meter = square track in #F4F4F4 with black fill and a plain readout ('7 of 10 steps'); restart = outline square. Static only; nothing decoratively animates (motion gated, per the standard's animation doctrine).
decisions.evidence: gated-motion doctrine observed; primitives attested
decisions.reasoning: Composes attested primitives; honours the motion doctrine.

decisions.decision: Empty state = plain ruled statement + one action; no imagery (imagery absence is a system property).
decisions.evidence: no imagery style defined; protectionist posture observed
decisions.reasoning: Absence, honestly expressed.

decisions.decision: Ledger = ruled register: 2px black header rule over medium labels, 1px pewter hairlines between rows, no zebra; row hover = #F4F4F4; status labels inline per D-10.
decisions.evidence: ruled/measured register; table structures implied by document culture
decisions.reasoning: Documents are the system's native form.

decisions.decision: Dialog = square white sheet, 2px black frame, black scrim at 55%, instant; no motion.
decisions.evidence: flat ruled language; motion gated
decisions.reasoning: Same doctrine as D-02/D-15.

decisions.decision: Plain, non-bureaucratic, task-first; gender-inclusive by default; no jargon, no sloganising; French rendered with equal care (never machine-dumped).
decisions.evidence: plain-language mandate + style guide principles quoted
decisions.reasoning: Directly mandated and quoted.

decisions.decision: Bilingual side-by-side collapses to over-under (the observed fallback rule); nav collapses to a plain row; scaling is quiet (no mobile-specific scale invented).
decisions.evidence: over-and-under fallback quoted from the standard; collapse behavior authored minimally
decisions.reasoning: The observed fallback IS the responsive doctrine; applied honestly.

decisions.decision: Focus = 2px black outer ring offset 2px (visible on any ground); no colour used for focus. Merged implementation with D-11 field focus.
decisions.evidence: none captured
decisions.reasoning: Structural, colour-free focus matches the doctrine.

decisions.decision: Never: corner radii; shadows; decorative colour; red for status/errors/decoration; imagery; pictograms (undefined in source); slogan-style headings; playful shapes; Crown marks reproduced.
decisions.evidence: stated absences + legal protection posture
decisions.reasoning: Codifies the closed grammar.
